templates.heading: Curated templates
templates.intro: Click a card to preview it big. When you're ready, hit Use this template in the banner to clone it into a new project.
templates.newProjectWarning: Picking a template starts a new project. Your current project stays saved in /projects.
templates.footer: Templates are static HTML — pure markup, Tailwind CDN, Google Fonts. Cloning makes them yours; only your project claims a subdomain when you hit Deploy.
templates.cannotApply: You can’t apply a template to a page you’re already editing. Create a new page to use one.
templates.restyleHint: Pick a template to restyle this page — your content stays, the design changes. Uses credits.

sections.intro: Preview any section, then use it on your page — it's matched to your colors and dropped into the right spot.
sections.jsTooltip: Renders content via JS — preserved on insert, limited inline-edit
sections.imgTooltip: Ships gradient placeholders — swap real images after insert
sections.footer: Navbars and footers replace the existing one; everything else stacks where it fits.
sections.useHint: It adapts to your page's colors when you use it.
